decimal_comparison_definition: exact binary64 numerical value (Decimal.from_float) compared with reconstructed 180-digit bounds; exact Decimal-generated price classification is not substituted
roundtrip_text_comparison_definition: the shortest round-trip decimal serialization of the binary64 price compared with the same 180-digit bounds; reported separately because it can differ at a boundary
join_definition: option type, S/K, days, target IV, and stored binary64 price; duplicate or unmatched case keys are rejected
scope: generated synthetic near-bound cases only; not a market failure rate
